knowledge:
- key_parameters: distance_metric=Specifies the distance metric to use in odseq (e.g., "affine") ;; B=The number of bootstrap replicates to run for threshold calculation (e.g., 1000) ;; type=Specifies whether the input matrix for odseq_unaligned is a "similarity" or "distance" matrix
- alternatives: odseq (for aligned sequences, which is highly accurate but requires computationally expensive multiple sequence alignment) vs. odseq_unaligned (for unaligned sequences, which is faster for large datasets but requires a precomputed similarity or distance matrix)
- when_to_use: Use when you have a set of sequences (e.g., from a PFAM family) and want to identify and discard outlier/noise sequences that could degrade the quality of a multiple sequence alignment.
- pitfalls: odseq_unaligned is highly dependent on the type of metric/kernel used; simple kernels like the spectrum kernel do not consider relative letter positions, which can heavily reduce outlier detection accuracy compared to using aligned sequences.

workflows.name: aligned_sequence_outlier_detection
workflows.intent: Detect outlier sequences from a set of sequences by first performing a multiple sequence alignment.
input: seqs (AAStringSet or DNAStringSet of biological sequences to be aligned and analyzed)
workflows.stages: 1. Perform multiple sequence alignment using msa ;; 2. Run outlier detection using odseq with a specified distance metric and bootstrap parameter
workflows.code:
set.seed(93)
library(odseq)
data("seqs")
library(msa)
alig <- msa(seqs)
ground_values <- c(rep(FALSE, 211), rep(TRUE, 100))
outliers <- odseq(alig, distance_metric = "affine", B = 1000)
mean(outliers == ground_values)

workflows.name: unaligned_sequence_outlier_detection
workflows.intent: Detect outlier sequences from unaligned sequences using a precomputed similarity or distance matrix to save alignment computation time.
input: seqs (AAStringSet or DNAStringSet of biological sequences)
workflows.stages: 1. Compute a similarity matrix using a string kernel from the kebabs package ;; 2. Run outlier detection on the similarity matrix using odseq_unaligned
workflows.code:
library(kebabs)
sp <- spectrumKernel(k = 3)
mat <- getKernelMatrix(sp, seqs)
outliers_unaligned <- odseq_unaligned(mat, B = 1000, type = "similarity")
mean(outliers_unaligned == ground_values)
